'''Rondale Merced''', or '''Lee Merced''', was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] who was a member of the organization known as the [[Black Bha'lir]]. Together with fellow Black Bha'lir member [[Vance Caelli]], Merced founded the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]] company, which was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] and manufactured illegal [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] in addition to ground vehicles and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upgrade components. At some point following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Merced and Caelli disappeared under mysterious circumstances, leaving their [[Gender/Legends|nephew]] [[Pret Swain]] as the sole head of the Caelli-Merced Syndicate.

==Biography==
[[File:Pret_Swain.png|thumb|right|250px|Rondale Merced and Vance Caelli made their nephew Pret Swain (pictured) a full partner of their company, the Caelli-Merced Syndicate.]]
Rondale Merced, also known as Lee Merced, was an infamous [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Arms dealer/Legends|weapons dealer]] who was a prominent member of the [[Black Bha'lir]], an organization of smugglers and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that was based in<ref name="Socorro" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro]] and [[Omman Minor system/Legends|Omman Minor systems]]. They and their fellow Black Bha'lir member [[Vance Caelli]] were [[Gender/Legends|uncles]] of [[Pret Swain]], a young man from<ref name="Socorro" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Socorro" />

At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Merced and Caelli founded the highly profitable corporation known as the [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]]. The company was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] and manufactured illegal [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]&mdash;with it being the only weapons manufacturing enterprise on Socorro&mdash;as well as ground vehicles and upgrade components for [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Socorro" />

At the time of the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]]<ref name="Socorro" /> by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Swain was visiting with his uncles on Socorro. When news of the event reached the planet, Merced and Caelli offered the devastated [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]], who had nowhere to turn, to become a full partner of the Caelli-Merced Syndicate and help run the company&mdash;an offer that Swain accepted. At one point, Merced and Caelli both disappeared under mysterious circumstances, leaving Swain as the sole leader of the corporation and rendering him relatively paranoid.<ref name="Socorro" />

==Personality and traits==
Similarly to their partner Vance Caelli and nephew Pret Swain, Rondale Merced had a smooth and amiable personality.<ref name="Socorro" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rondale Merced was introduced in ''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]'', a [[1997]] sourcebook authored by [[Patricia A. Jackson]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Socorro" />
